descriptions.d41g_flow_start_8006c4a8: Starts the game flow object: loads the FCS title and menu timeouts, clears a flag, loads the sound bank, subscribes to 28 messages, walks the command line arguments in upper case (names after / or + post their debug messages, plus flags HOST, JOIN, NOAUTOLOOP and VALIDATEGAMESTATE), falls back to the default mode, posts the default level message and loads the game over resource.
